sample_unit: reasoning steps (plus 150 steps in clinical expert audit)

links.outcome: Medical QA benchmark answer metrics versus step-level factuality of reasoning traces after CoT distillation
links.effect: MedQA-USMLE SC@64 rose 74.7% to 84.4% and ECE fell 0.096 to 0.034, while step error rate rose from 30.6% to 50.3% under an LLM-judge audit.
links.quote: Yet under a Kimi-K2.6 style-blind LLM-judge audit, its error rate over non-abstained steps rises from 30.6% to 50.3%.

unlisted_practices: Step-level audit of reasoning-trace factuality in addition to final-answer metrics for distilled medical models
Expert clinician blinded audit of reasoning steps

screen.reason: The study conducts an empirical safety/factuality audit of medical chain-of-thought distillation across medical benchmarks, demonstrating that final answer accuracy dissociates from step-level reasoning quality.
